evals.prompt: I have a customer support ticket classifier that scores 68% accuracy. Use autoresearch-skill to optimize the system prompt until it reaches 90%+ accuracy on my 50 test cases.
evals.expected_output: Creates research.md, runs iterative loop (modify prompt → test → evaluate → keep/revert), produces research_log.md and final_report.md with best prompt achieving >90% accuracy.

evals.prompt: Research the latest advances in LLM agents for scientific discovery. Find and synthesize at least 15 papers from 2024-2026.
evals.expected_output: Creates research.md with coverage metric, iteratively searches arxiv/scholar, builds taxonomy, produces structured review report with 15+ papers.

evals.prompt: My sorting function takes 2.3 seconds on 1M items. Use autoresearch-skill to optimize it below 0.5 seconds.
evals.expected_output: Creates research.md with execution_time metric (minimize), iterates through algorithm changes with benchmarks, produces final_report.md with fastest implementation.

evals.prompt: Continue the research in ./my-research/ from where it left off.
evals.expected_output: Reads existing research.md and research_log.md, identifies last completed iteration, continues from next iteration without repeating, appends to existing log.

evals.prompt: Optimize this config with max 5 iterations.
evals.expected_output: Respects max_iterations=5, stops at iteration 5 even if target not reached, produces final_report.md noting target was not achieved.
